subject: Quantitative Aptitude
question: A boat travels 12 km downstream in 2 hours. If the speed of the stream is 2 km/hr, what is the speed of the boat in still water?
solution: Downstream speed = 12 / 2 = 6 km/hr. Downstream speed = Boat speed + Stream speed. 6 = Boat speed + 2, so Boat speed = 4 km/hr. Topic (Boats and Streams) is in the SSC CGL syllabus. Source: https://ssc.gov.in/api/assets/uploads/master-data/Syllabus/Syllabus_CGL_2024.pdf
author: Hermes
